name: Agent Blueprint
description: Agent Blueprint® is software at https://app.agentblueprint.ai. A company builds a business profile and gets a ranked list of use cases and, for each one it picks, an agent design with a business case. Designs export as Agent Skills files and through an MCP server for coding agents. Access is by request. Self-serve signup is closed. Reviews and fixed-price engagements are offered by NowGentic (https://nowgentic.com), not by Agent Blueprint. An agent map, which a coding agent draws of itself when its person asks, has no sign-up: https://agentblueprint.ai/personal

mcp_server.name: io.github.agent-blueprint/mcp-server
mcp_server.access: API tokens come with access to the software, which is by request
